[View the ADEQ Hourly Forecast for Yuma]
Satellite this morning shows that more cloud cover is in the area, and daily ozone levels will be lower today. There will be less cloud cover over the weekend and into early next week,

areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today and tomorrow, light and variable winds throughout the period will lead to pollutant accumulation in the Imperial Valley. Furthermore, temperature inversions during the morning and evening hours will trap pollutants near the ground. Although low pollutant carryover will lead to high-Good AQI le
